name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name; accurately reflects the function: resolve one melee hit and smoothly drain the defender HP bar from pre-hit to post-hit length. No address residue. 'combat'/'hp_drain' match the body (damage calc + per-pixel bar shrink loop).
purpose: Resolve and play one melee attack hit (looping for double-strike / RNG extra-hit budget), then smoothly drain the defender's on-screen HP bar from its pre-hit length down to the post-hit length.
logic_summary: hits_remaining starts at 1; equipped weapon (slot 0) effect entry is fetched and weapon_entry[+9] (special_type) == 3 ('double' weapon class) sets budget to 2. One RNG draw is then taken UNCONDITIONALLY (always advances the shared seed) and if (draw % 100 < 3) the budget is also raised to 2 (flat 3% extra-hit proc). Per hit: capture pre-hit bar_numerator = defender.hp_current * 0x46; call fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation (applies damage, returns surviving HP); play fd2_animate_attack_hit_sequence; then shrink the bar one pixel per frame from (bar_numerator / hp_max) down to ((surviving_HP*0x45)/hp_max + 1), calling fd2_render_combat_hp_bar_segments at dst=(panel_xy[1]+6)*320 + panel_xy[0] + 0xA0007 with ~8 BIOS-tick (fd2_delay_ms(8)) pacing. Loop ends when budget exhausted or defender dies. Returns 0 if defender died, else surviving HP.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_animate_combat_hit_with_hp_drain(uint32 attacker_idx, uint32 defender_idx, uint32 panel_xy_ptr)

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the attacker (caller passes caster/target). Used for the equipped-weapon lookup and as the attacker arg to the damage calc and hit-sequence animation.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value; no address residue.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the defender. Indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr for pre-hit hp_current/hp_max and is the damage-calc / hit-sequence target.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value; no address residue.

params.name: panel_xy_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the combat-panel descriptor returned by fd2_animate_combat_speech_bubbles (caller passes pCombat_anim_state or +8 for the retaliation). Body reads [+0]=panel x and [+4]=panel y to compute the HP-bar draw destination inside the 0xA0000 combat overlay surface.
params.reason: Name reflects that it is a pointer to an (x,y) panel-position pair; no address residue. (Caller's value is a descriptor whose first two ints are the panel x,y.)

returns.semantics: 0 = defender died (consumed by caller as the 'first hit landed' boolean gating the counter-attack); otherwise the defender's surviving HP after the final hit.
